title: vignea drejeri
intro: Vignea drejeri, commonly known as "Indian spikenard" or "Vetiver", is a type of perennial grass native to India and other parts of Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce stress, anxiety, and insomnia, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Vignea drejeri include its sedative and calming effects, which can help to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
